description: MoziAI-35B: Local open-source financial AI LLM. 35B MoE model compressed to 15.5GB via MoziSmartBit quantization. 256K context, vision, tool calling, 140+ tok/s on consumer GPU. Based on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.
